calls.statement:
SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, city, region, format, sqm, open_date, close_date, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current ORDER BY sqm DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20)
   OR store_id >= 900
ORDER BY store_id, valid_from

calls.statement:
SELECT c.store_id, c.store_name, c.region, c.format, c.sqm, c.open_date, c.close_date,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT sqm) FROM dim_store v WHERE v.store_id = c.store_id) AS n_sqm_values,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_store v WHERE v.store_id = c.store_id) AS n_versions
FROM dim_store c
WHERE c.is_current AND c.store_id < 900
ORDER BY c.sqm DESC
LIMIT 20

calls.statement:
SELECT r.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm, round(sum(r.net_sales),0) AS net_sales_fy2526,
       rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(r.net_sales) DESC) AS sales_rank
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = r.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND r.store_id < 900
GROUP BY r.store_id, s.store_name, s.sqm
ORDER BY net_sales_fy2526 DESC
LIMIT 14
